verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own Linear Agent, which takes plain-language job descriptions through Loops, edits text, drafts updates and helps develop projects. An official Linear MCP server also lets Claude and Cursor drive Linear conversationally. These are task-specific agent surfaces, though; the evidence never shows general natural-language operation of the product, such as creating, filtering, triaging or navigating issues by command. missing for 10: documented general-purpose NL command interface covering core issue-tracking operations, details of what the MCP server lets NL clients do, independent/hands-on corroboration of NL operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
